articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin hack continued hours after exchange said attack was contained, report finds
articles.snippet: The same attacker took about $391,000, mostly from wallets Bitquery ties to BitMart, whose founder confirmed a Nov. 2 hack and suspects a link.

articles.title: OpenAI says its AI can break into Linux at scale. Here's what it means for crypto
articles.snippet: OpenAI says its AI found 948 Linux flaws and wrote a working attack for each one. Crypto security voices say decentralization leaves the industry better placed than most to cope.

articles.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
articles.snippet: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

articles.title: Fed, OCC check US banks after Binance hack as experts flag security risks
articles.snippet: US regulators reportedly contacted banks following last week’s $6.3 billion Binance security hack, while experts raised concerns about transaction security and crypto risks.

articles.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa resumes operations after attack, assesses losses
articles.snippet: The bank said customer funds were unaffected after attackers accessed its systems through a service provider’s platform.
